in_arabic.name: نَزْرُول
in_arabic.meaning: وَصِيَةٌ مِنَ اللَهِ وَرَضِيَةٌ مِنَ النَسَبِ
in_arabic.long_meaning: نَزْرُول، الَّذي يَشير إلى الَّذي يَقُبِلُ اللَهُ وَيُرضى بِهِ، وَهُوَ الَّذي يَخُذُ وَصِيَةً مِنَ اللَهِ وَيُحِبُّها، وَهُوَ الَّذي يَجْلِسُ عَلى وَصِيَةِ النَبِيِّينَ، وَهُوَ الَّذي يَقُبِلُ اللَهُ وَيُرضى بِهِ وَيُجَلِّسُهُ عَلى وَصِيَةِ النَبِيِّينَ، وَهُوَ الَّذي يَحِبُّ اللَهُ مِنَ النَسَبِ، وَهُوَ الَّذي يُقَرِّرُ اللَهُ بِهِ وَيُؤَمِّنُهُ، وَهُوَ الَّذي يُعَرِّفُهُ اللَهُ بِالنَصِيحَةِ وَيُؤمِنُهُ وَيَجْلِسُهُ عَلى وَصِيَةِ النَبِيِّينَ

in_english.name: Nazrul

It is a name that is derived from the Arabic root 'nazara', which means to look or to see, and 'rullah', which means Allah. In Islamic tradition, names are believed to hold spiritual significance and Nazrul is no exception. It is a name that is associated with qualities such as righteousness, nobility, and compassion. In Arabic, the name Nazrul is written as نَزْرُول and is considered a handsome and elegant name. In Urdu, it is written as نَزْرُول and is a popular name among Muslims in South Asia. In Hindi, it is written as नज़रूल and is a name that is often given to boys. In Pashto, it is written as نَزْرُول and is a name that is commonly used in Afghanistan and Pakistan. In Turkish, it is written as Nazırul and is a name that is associated with nobility and righteousness.
